module_interface.name: Module Interface & Contract Definition
module_interface.description: Define module API surface, machine-readable contract JSON, TypeScript/JSDoc types, and mock fixtures before writing implementation.
suggestedDefinitionOfDone: Interface contract defined with inputs, outputs, and errors in devkit
Exported function signatures and types declared
Mock fixtures or test doubles created for consumer testing

core_implementation.name: Core Module Implementation
core_implementation.description: Implement business logic satisfying declared interface contract with full unit test coverage.
suggestedDefinitionOfDone: All declared contract methods implemented cleanly
Unit test suite passing with 0 exit code
No unexpected external package dependencies added
deliverables: Implementation source files in declared write scope

integration_wiring.name: Cross-Module Integration Wiring
integration_wiring.description: Connect upstream producer module to downstream consumer module and verify cross-boundary data flow.
suggestedDefinitionOfDone: Consumer cleanly calls producer via contract API
Integration test passes with real components wired
Boundary error handling and failure modes verified

repro_bugfix.name: Repro-First Bug Fix
repro_bugfix.description: Write a reproducing test that fails first (Red), apply minimal fix to make it pass (Green), and preserve all existing regressions.
suggestedDefinitionOfDone: Reproducing test created that fails on baseline code
Targeted fix applied making reproducer pass
Full project regression tests pass with 0 exit code

refactor_safe.name: Safe Architectural Refactoring
refactor_safe.description: Refactor module structure, state management, or performance while strictly preserving 100% of existing contracts and behavioral tests.
suggestedDefinitionOfDone: Existing public API contracts and signatures 100% preserved
All pre-existing test suites pass without modifications to test logic
Target structural, modularity, or performance improvement verified
